messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (p95 latency spike). Monitored threshold breached at 22:02 UTC. incident_id=inc-2026-03-14-022. @here

maria gonzalez: I’m on it, grabbing logs and looking at recent deploys.

ajay patel: I see increased queue depth on the batcher. Spawning more workers now.

oncall-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-inc-2026-03-14-022. Runbook pointer: /runbooks/generation-high-5xx.md

helena cho: Any error class? tokenization? model OOM?

samir rao: Errors look like "context-length-exceeded" then fallback path triggered, followed by downstream handler throwing 500. Pasting filtered log snippet: 
```
2026-03-14T22:01:38Z ERROR handler.go:213 request=abc123 err="kv cache miss -> fallback handler failed: downstream: 500"
2026-03-14T22:01:39Z WARN batcher.go:88 backlog=154 inflight=12
```

maria gonzalez: Rolling back the 21:45 model tweak (candidate v2-quant-fast) from canary to stable to test.

ajay patel: Scaling Dedicated pool up +3 nodes (manual) — should reduce queue. ETA ~2m.

helena cho: Noted customer impact: a few high-volume customers saw error spikes for ~3 minutes starting 22:01 UTC, auto-retry masked some but others surfaced to app errors. Product-ops, can we flag top affected accounts?

product-ops: pulling account hit list now. Will DM affected PMs and set a banner if >5% failed for any org.

pagerbot: Escalation: paging senior infra (helena cho) due to multi-tenant impact.

samir rao: After rollback + scale, 5xx rate back down to baseline at 22:06. Root cause hypothesis: quantized model triggered a code path that hits a cache-miss cascade and a downstream timeout.

ajay patel: Agreed. I want to keep the rollback until we validate offline. We also need a gradual canary process to avoid global impact.

maria gonzalez: Will pin stable model on hosted API and open a dedicated test fleet for v2-quant-fast.

helena cho: OK. For the on-call handoff: I’m staying on for the next 30m to confirm remediation. @samir you own the post-incident writeup and action items, please coordinate with product-ops.

samir rao: Taking post-incident. I’ll schedule a 30-min postmortem sync tomorrow. Proposed time: 2026-03-15 16:00 UTC.

product-ops: Noted. I’ll collate the customer impact list and include timestamps and affected models.

maria gonzalez: Quick action items while hot:
- rollback confirmed (maria)
- scale nodes (ajay)
- block v2-quant-fast canary (maria)
- collect detailed logs + KV cache traces from 21:50–22:10 (samir)

ajay patel: Done scaling. I'll also add a temporary routing rule to favor dedicated non-quant models in case of noisy canaries.

oncall-bot: Handoff note: helena will stay until 22:36 UTC, then hand off to ajay for night coverage. Add note to incident channel when done.

helena cho: Handoff complete — leaving channel. ajay taking over. :wave:

ajay patel: Taking over. Monitoring for regressions. Also adding a metric alert for "fallback-handler-duration" so we catch this earlier.

samir rao: Post-incident doc draft: will include timeline, rollback rationale, telemetry, and three remediation items. Draft link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/incident/inc-2026-03-14-022 (will update after initial notes).

maria gonzalez: Important runbook/update request: the runbook currently suggests a full rollout stop but not the specific safe-canary steps for quantized models. We should add a checklist: (1) disable global canary, (2) route <1% traffic to canary, (3) enable kv cache tracing, (4) monitor fallback-rate for 15m.

helena cho: Also add an escalation threshold: if fallback-rate > 0.5% and p95 latency > 600ms for 5m, auto-roll back and page infra.

samir rao: Will create action items in the postmortem:
- ACTION-1: Update runbook: safe canary recipe for quantized models (owner: maria gonzalez, due: 2026-03-20).
- ACTION-2: Add metric and alert for fallback-handler-duration and fallback-rate (owner: ajay patel, due: 2026-03-18).
- ACTION-3: Add integration test exercising kv cache miss path under quantized models in CI (owner: samir rao, due: 2026-03-25).

product-ops: Customer comms plan: we’ll send an internal incident note to affected PMs now and prepare an external status page blurb if impact > 10 customers.

maria gonzalez: One more runbook tweak: include exact commands for pinning model in hosted API:
```
# pin model to stable
redwood model pin --model v2-quant-fast --pin=stable --org org-id
```
Add rollback checklist and owner contact matrix.

ajay patel: For Dedicated pools, document how to add burst nodes quickly and the expected time requirement. I’ll make a short doc and link it into the runbook.

samir rao: Scheduling the postmortem: created calendar invite for 2026-03-15 16:00 UTC, invite includes infra, runtime, product-ops, and devex. Agenda: timeline + evidence (10m), root cause hypotheses (10m), action items & owners (5m), runbook updates (5m).

helena cho: Thanks all. Quick note for incident command process: we should consider an explicit "canary owner" role during releases who can abort canary without full incident lead. Add to playbook.

maria gonzalez: Agree. Add role: canary-owner, with ability to block canary traffic and pin models. (owner: maria gonzalez to draft playbook change, due: 2026-03-22).

ajay patel: Leaving night monitoring now. If anything pops, page infra-senior.

oncall-bot: Incident inc-2026-03-14-022 transitioned to "mitigated" at 22:06 UTC. Postmortem required: yes.

samir rao: Closing notes for thread: I’ll upload initial postmortem draft by EOD today and link the action tracker. Thanks for the quick moves.

product-ops: Sending internal note to affected teams now. Will follow up with customer comms if needed. :white_check_mark:

maria gonzalez: Added runbook PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/pull/142 — includes safe-canary checklist and the canary-owner role. Please review.

samir rao: Marking action items in tracker and assigning. Will ping assignees tomorrow during postmortem.

ajay patel: Night handover: no open mitigations, monitoring stable since 22:10. Sharing brief on-call notes in #eng-oncall as usual.

pagerbot: Reaction: :thumbsup: from helena cho, ajay patel, maria gonzalez

maria gonzalez: Thanks team. Follow-ups in the postmortem.
